messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: PROD_SYNTH_RUNNER - page fired (severity: P4)
incident-bot: details: service=runtime-synth region=eu-central-1 symptom="synthetic overlap" count=24 window=45s
Noah R: acked. i'll take a look — is this localized to the synthetic runner or runtime?
Priya S: only synthetic-check routes showing 503s. real traffic green per CDN logs.
Jules M: we had a cron overlap at 22:00 where two runners kicked off same job; retries piled up.
Noah R: tail from synth runner log:
```
2026-06-12T22:00:00Z synth-runner[pid=413]: info start run_id=run-e7d1
2026-06-12T22:00:01Z synth-runner: warn overlap_detected=true run_id=run-e7d2
2026-06-12T22:00:02Z runtime: warn route=/health status=503 attempt=1
2026-06-12T22:00:03Z runtime: warn route=/health status=503 attempt=2
```
Priya S: aggregator saw the spike from synthetic cluster and fired PD. no customer-facing errors.
Noah R: i'll patch scheduler to add jitter and backoff on retries. applying quick change to job config.
Noah R: patch:
```
- schedule: "0 * * * *"
+ schedule: "0 * * * *"
+ jitter_seconds: 45
+ retry_backoff: 2
```
incident-bot: Alert status: acknowledged by Noah R. Pending escalate in 4m if not resolved.
Noah R: pushing suppression for synthetic-only aggregates from 30s -> 180s temporarily.
ops-bot: config-change: alerts.suppression.synthetic_only=180s (user=Noah R)
Jules M: metrics: synthetic failure wave subsided by 22:00:38. aggregator histogram shows spike duration ~18s.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: PROD_SYNTH_RUNNER - auto-resolved (duration: 41s)
Priya S: adding runbook note: add jitter to all scheduled synth jobs, and make synthetic-only alerts lower-severity.
Noah R: handing off to @Jules M for overnight watch. will follow up with PR to make jitter defaults enforced in templates.
Jules M: taking handoff :wave: will merge PR tomorrow AM and revert temporary suppression when deploy done.
